record.name: Tactician
record.description: Tacticians are master strategists and battlefield commanders, using their analytical minds and tactical genius to develop complex battle plans and outmaneuver enemies.

effects.notes: Before striking, the Commander gains a surge of tactical acumen, briefly increasing their initiative by +2.

progression_tree.description: Develop your tactical awareness, gaining advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks related to the battlefield.

effects.notes: As the commander surveys the battlefield, intuition heightens their senses. They gain advantage on all Intelligence (Perception) checks for a brief moment, allowing them to pinpoint hidden threats or opportunities.

progression_tree.description: Develop complex battle plans, gaining advantage on Intelligence checks related to strategy and tactics.

effects.notes: While in a tactical mindset, the commander gains expertise on one ability check of their choice per session, granting advantage on that Intelligence check.

progression_tree.description: Gain insight into the battlefield, gaining a +2 bonus to Wisdom (Insight) checks.

effects.notes: As the commander unleashes a well-timed strike, their keen tactical mind sparks a flash of insight. The commander gains advantage on all Intelligence checks made before the start of their next turn.

dynamic_visuals.combat_stance: Assumes a battle-hardened stance with feet shoulder-width apart and lightsaber at the ready.
dynamic_visuals.energy_signature: Surrounds self with an aura of blue and red energy, indicative of a master tactician's control over the Force.

prompt_schema.base_prompt: A wise and seasoned commander stands on a windswept cliff overlooking a distant battlefield, lightsaber at their side.
contextual_modifiers: with a hint of moisture in the air
and a faint hum of starfighters in the distance
